description: renewable power plant is an open-source software tool listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Datasets on Electricity Consumption and Generation", published or maintained by Open-Power-System-Data (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). contains scripts to create lists of renewable power plants in Germany, Denmark, France and Poland, and daily time series of cumulated installed capacity per energy source type for Germany. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Datasets on Electricity Consumption and Generation" (electricity consumption and generation). The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity consumption and generation studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
